, Professor of the Oasis.

spans.text: What's wrong? Did you remember something?

units.displayText: To my surprise, I find that Clotho, who has always been quite inscrutable, now has teardrops beading in the corner of her eyes.

units.rawText: That voice just now... It was...
units.displayText: That voice just now... It was...

spans.text: That voice just now... It was...

units.rawText: Just now? What voice?
units.displayText: Just now? What voice?

spans.text: Just now? What voice?

units.rawText: I've been... been searching for all this time...
units.displayText: I've been... been searching for all this time...

spans.text: I've been... been searching for all this time...

units.rawText: Gunsmoke and battlefields... From reality to the cloud server... I've been... been searching all this time...
units.displayText: Gunsmoke and battlefields... From reality to the cloud server... I've been... been searching all this time...

spans.text: Gunsmoke and battlefields... From reality to the cloud server... I've been... been searching all this time...

units.rawText: Wait, is the person you're looking for...
units.displayText: Wait, is the person you're looking for...

spans.text: Wait, is the person you're looking for...

units.rawText: As confusion fills the air, the door to the Ops Room just so happens to open.
units.displayText: As confusion fills the air, the door to the Ops Room just so happens to open.

spans.text: As confusion fills the air, the door to the Ops Room just so happens to open.

units.rawText: I'm here, Master.
units.displayText: I'm here, Master.

spans.text: I'm here, Master.

units.rawText: Upon seeing the person who has arrived, Clotho immediately says her name—
units.displayText: Upon seeing the person who has arrived, Clotho immediately says her name—

spans.text: Upon seeing the person who has arrived, Clotho immediately says her name—

units.rawText: Centaureissi!
units.displayText: Centaureissi!

spans.text: Centaureissi!

units.rawText: Centaureissi stares at Clotho in shock, but only for a moment. Then her mouth curls up in a faint smile.
units.displayText: Centaureissi stares at Clotho in shock, but only for a moment. Then her mouth curls up in a faint smile.

spans.text: Centaureissi stares at Clotho in shock, but only for a moment. Then her mouth curls up in a faint smile.

units.rawText: It's been a while, Clotho.
units.displayText: It's been a while, Clotho.

spans.text: It's been a while, Clotho.

units.rawText: The formerly aloof girl doesn't hesitate. She lunges at Centaureissi, and what starts as intermittent sobs soon becomes full-blown wailing.
units.displayText: The formerly aloof girl doesn't hesitate. She lunges at Centaureissi, and what starts as intermittent sobs soon becomes full-blown wailing.

spans.text: The formerly aloof girl doesn't hesitate. She lunges at Centaureissi, and what starts as intermittent sobs soon becomes full-blown wailing.

units.rawText: Faced with this, Centaureissi simply pats her shoulder gently and smiles.
units.displayText: Faced with this, Centaureissi simply pats her shoulder gently and smiles.

spans.text: Faced with this, Centaureissi simply pats her shoulder gently and smiles.

units.rawText: It's alright... It's alright now.
units.displayText: It's alright... It's alright now.

spans.text: It's alright... It's alright now.

units.rawText: ...Maybe I should send Dushevnaya and...
units.displayText: ...Maybe I should send Dushevnaya and...

spans.text: ...Maybe I should send Dushevnaya and...

units.rawText: Pardon me, Master. Give us a bit of time; just a few moments will do...
units.displayText: Pardon me, Master. Give us a bit of time; just a few moments will do...

spans.text: Pardon me, Master. Give us a bit of time; just a few moments will do...

units.rawText: The sound of her palm gently patting Clotho's back blends with the trailing sound of her voice. Then, as though in time with that ethereal requiem, Centaureissi begins telling a story from a long, long time ago...
